speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I understand you are experiencing hand tremors and recent memory issues; to begin my assessment, how long have you noticed these symptoms occurring?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the progression from a unilateral hand tremor affecting fine motor skills alongside memory deficits in a 70-year-old is concerning. To differentiate between essential tremor and Parkinson's disease, does the tremor in your left hand occur when you are at rest, or does it happen only when you are trying to use your hands, like while reading?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.
